ledger: 00:00-00:09: Outdoor calm dusk air; truck exhaust/steam rises and disperses gently with a slight breeze from left to right, consistent with the still surrounding environment.
00:10-00:26: Indoor diner environment; calm air, clothing and hair of the waitress and customer hang naturally under gravity and respond only to their walking and wiping movements.
00:27-00:31: Gravity acting on poured coffee; liquid streams straight down from carafe spout into mug consistently.
00:32-00:44: Indoor thermal convection; steam from the hot egg and toast rises vertically in the still diner air without unexplained lateral drafts.
01:37-01:40: Gravity and friction on paper currency; bills placed on the counter settle flat without unexplained airflow.
01:41-01:49: Outdoor morning air; customer walks toward parked truck with no wind deformation on hair, jacket, or background grass, consistent across both angles.
